lead: Every `Fault::thrown` site owes a case printing its message, or an "unreachable from source" declaration.
body: `every_error_path_is_asserted_or_declared_unreachable` greps each message's stem across every case file, so a message that interpolates a dependency's text cannot be asserted. Give a refusal a fixed sentence, and satisfy the gate with `catch (LogicError $e) { echo $e->message, "\n"; }`.
